DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 1) { self.cancellable2 = pub.sink { print ("Stream 2 received: \($0)") } } DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 2) { self.connectable = pub.connect() } // Prints: // Stream 2 received: Sent // Stream 1 received: Sent ```
